query:
SELECT
            b.id,
            b.title,
            b.narrator,
            (
                SELECT a.name
                FROM book_authors ba
                JOIN authors a ON a.id = ba.author_id
                WHERE ba.book_id = b.id
                ORDER BY a.name ASC
                LIMIT 1
            ) AS author
        FROM books b
        WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audiobook_files af WHERE af.book_id = b.id)
          AND (b.title ILIKE $1 OR COALESCE(b.narrator, '') ILIKE $1)
        ORDER BY b.title
        LIMIT $2
